% Invented formulas: diagonal marks, a value on a fraction, and colour
% scoped inside an alignment. Every mark is held by the shipped census.
\documentclass{article}
\fonts{ dir = "fonts", body = "Source Serif Pro", math = "Fira Math" }
\usepackage{amsmath,xcolor}
\usepackage[makeroom]{cancel}
\title{Annotated Formulas}

\begin{document}

\maketitle

The three diagonal marks preserve their operands:
$\cancel{x} + \bcancel{y} + \xcancel{a+b}$.

A value sits beside the arrow and above its operand:
\[
  \cancelto{0}{\frac{r}{s}} + t^2
\]

Colour stays inside its group, including the arrow and value:
\begin{align*}
  a &= {\color{red}\textcolor{blue}{\cancelto{7}{z}}} + w^2
\end{align*}

\end{document}
